question.question_text: If you are in the storage room, how can you retrieve the orange towel?

answer_options.text: Exit the storage room and turn left. Walk forward and through the bathroom door. The orange towel is hanging on the towel rack.
Exit the storage room and walk forward to the staircase. Turn left into the living room and the orange towel is lying on the couch.
Exit the storage room and turn left into the kitchen. The orange towel is hanging on the handle of the oven.
Exit the storage room and turn left. Go through the first door on the left and walk forward into the kitchen. The orange towel is hanging on the handle of the oven.
Exit the storage room and turn right. Go through the door, and then go through the door on the left into the bathroom. The orange towel is hanging on the towel rack.
